title: INFO HUD
description: This project adds a very useful gui where you can see things
body:
A lightweight HUD overlay mod that shows contextual info about what you're looking at, plus always-visible stats.

## Features
🔍 Looking-At Panel (top corner, animated)
Shows a **gray semi-transparent box** (80% opaque) that slides in when you look at something, and slides off-screen upward in 0.2 seconds when you look away.

📊 Stats Bar (below the panel, always visible)
Always-on stats rendered in the same corner:

- XYZ Coords — your current position
- FPS — current frames per second
- CPS — clicks per second (left mouse button)
- BPS — blocks broken per second

⚙️ Settings GUI (press M)
Opens an in-game screen where you can:

Looking At Left / Right · On / Off
Coords Left / Right · On / Off
FPS Left / Right · On / Off
CPS Left / Right · On / Off
BPS Left / Right · On / Off

Settings are saved automatically to %appdata%\.minecraft\config\infoview.json


## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ for Minecraft 26.1
2. Install Fabric API (matching 26.1)
3. Drop infoview-1.0.0.jar into your`mods/ folder
4. Launch!
